correctness.rationale: Reconstructed fixed-denominator burden from ordered seed-destination connectivity; verified deterministic component-attachment algebra and its disconnected case; proved four-vertex sign by an at-most-two-residual-vertices inequality and general forests by unique-path positive supermodular indicators. Independently checked five-cycle formulas, each remaining S/pair class, derivative root uniqueness, and exact p=19/20 negative witness. The included stdlib checker enumerates 83,506 deterministic structural cases and all 32 five-cycle open states; these finite checks corroborate, not replace, the general proof.

originality.rationale: Archived immunization and reachability literature, exact small-graph epidemiology, SI-tree submodularity under a different seeding model, and newer non-submodularity work were materially compared by implication. Generic vaccination synergy was expressly prior; no inspected source supplies this exact sharp order-four universal guarantee, the entire C5 probability phase, and the structural mixed-difference identity together. Residual risk: unindexed or uninspected equivalent graph reliability/submodularity result.
residual_risks: An older graph-reliability or critical-node result could imply the exact formula without using the same terminology.
The 2024 network-immunization paper already knows non-submodularity in other seeding setups; the novelty claim is carefully limited to the exact quantified classification.
Not every page and appendix of every neighboring article was materially read; independent literature validation was not performed.

value.rationale: Diminishing returns governs whether standard incremental vaccine-selection reasoning is justified. The four-to-five vertex boundary and complete critical-transmissibility phase supply a motivated sharp obstruction, and the all-graph parallel-route identity explains exactly which redundant transmission channels cause negative synergy. The theorem is model-specific and not a field-performance prediction; it is not merely a renaming of qualitative non-submodularity.
